title: Observer skips lifetime checks on received leaves
description: RFC 9420 §7.3: lifetime verification is MUST only for LeafNodes the client sends; for received LeafNodes (Proposal, Commit, or the ratchet tree of a group being joined) it is RECOMMENDED, 'because the LeafNode might have expired in the time between when the message was sent and when it was received'. Readings: (a) the hub/follower Observer verifies lifetimes like a member (OpenMLS PublicGroup default, no opt-out); (b) the Observer skips lifetime checks on all received leaves. Chosen: (b). The Observer only ever receives leaves; with (a) a hub cannot track any group containing a member whose leaf is older than its KeyPackage lifetime (84 days default), and the mlswg passive-client vectors (expired 2024-25) cannot be used. Signatures, tree hashes and all other leaf checks still apply. Requires patching the openmls mimid-0.9.1 branch (approved by Mark 2026-10-17). Members' policy is a separate bead.
